metadata.title: Epistemic Sovereignty & Collective Mind
metadata.notes: Protecting the integrity of the individual and collective mind in a connected world.

nodes.title: The Ecology of Attention
nodes.description: Attention as the primary currency of life. Identifying and resisting extractive attention-mining. Techniques for deep focus and cognitive boundaries in a decentralized mesh.

nodes.title: Bayesian Sense-Making
nodes.description: How to update your beliefs in a decentralized network. Understanding information weights based on source reputation (MATL) and graph distance. Detecting network-scale fallacies.

nodes.title: Philosophy of the Substrate
nodes.description: The history of technics from the printing press to Holochain. Why agent-centricity is a prerequisite for human flourishing. Critical analysis of centralized vs decentralized architectures.

nodes.title: The Epistemic Witness Capstone
nodes.description: Produce a high-signal communication artifact (report, audit, or research) that demonstrates perfect internal consistency and objective veracity. Verified by the Symthaea Auditor.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A 'Non-Hallucinating Artifact'—a piece of complex reasoning or reporting that passes the EML Structural Integrity test with a score > 900.

edges.rationale: One cannot witness truth without first mastering the ecology of their own attention.
Bayesian sense-making is the formal requirement for objective reporting.
Truth-telling in the digital age requires understanding the philosophy of the substrate.
